events.title: Update: experimental "On the beat" mode, sniper and mortar fixes
events.summary: This is an update to the full version. The Steam Next Fest demo stays as it is until the festival ends; the changes will reach it later."On the beat" mode (experiment). Settings, right under Difficulty, now has a "Step rhythm" switch. "Free" is the game as before. "On the beat" means that in combat your step goes only on the beat, one cell per beat, together with the enemies. events.title: AsterMaster is in Steam Next Fest — free demo, updated build

events.title: AsterMaster free demo is out now on Steam
events.summary: The AsterMaster demo is free — hit “Download Demo” on the store page.It isn’t “five minutes and credits”. It’s the asteroid’s first segment looped downward: clear the arena, a descent platform opens, and the next horizon hits harder than the last.What’s inside:— the full combat loop: weapon mods, synergies, power-ups, depths, smugglers and a bounty on your head — same as the full game;— a three-way fork before the first arena, a different mod in each passage: pick one and you walk into the boss
